title: Replying to a hub notification email posts the reply into the thread it came from

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/BqySUVMoZYsPcR49SBRUqB)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-24: signed reply addresses and the inbound router work for comms conversations only; a reply to a Plan comment or mention email bounces into nothing. Owner ruling 2026-11-24: email is the only outside channel for now (no Slack or WhatsApp). Fix: encode the item thread in the reply token, strip quoted text, post as the sender. Inbound mail counts against the Resend quota, so it goes through the daily quota valve.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
